run_xm_experiment: run an xmanager experiment that launches a CIFAR10 training job on Kubernetes with parameter server strategy
create_xm_python_container: create an xm.PythonContainer spec with a base image and entrypoint module for packaging
build_parameter_server_strategy: build an xm_tensorflow.ParameterServerStrategyBuilder with chief, worker, and ps executors on Kubernetes
package_xm_executable: package an xm.Packageable with executable spec, kubernetes executor spec, and args into an experiment
add_hyperparameter_trials: add hyperparameter trial jobs to an experiment by iterating over learning rate configurations
